title: Operate a Base

objectives.text: Lose all HQs, production structures and engineering rigs.
Deliver cargo, build a power station and produce a squad.
Replace the original HQ after its loss, using an emergency rig produced by the factory.
Spend credits repairing actual battle damage.

scenario_exceptions.detail: A finite late exercise column changes enemy composition and timing only; no training rule bonuses are applied.
Interface steps and their browser-local input records are separate from Go mission objectives. World completion alone does not certify selection, control groups, rally feedback or boarding input.

subtitles.speaker: Instructor Vale
subtitles.text: Gather cargo, protect your haulers, construct power and produce a squad. A strike team threatens the old HQ: preserve the factory, purchase an emergency rig there after the original HQ falls, then rebuild. Use paid repairs on a damaged vehicle. Scenario starting power is deliberately insufficient; build generation before adding more consumers.

subtitles.speaker: Instructor
subtitles.text: The old HQ will be attacked at two minutes. Keep the factory and 4,700 credits for an emergency rig plus replacement HQ safe.

subtitles.speaker: Operations
subtitles.text: The base cycle works. Protect the factory during the HQ attack. Purchase its 1,200-credit emergency rig, then construct a 3,500-credit replacement HQ and use paid recovery on damaged units.

subtitles.speaker: Instructor
subtitles.text: The late exercise detachment has entered the eastern road.

subtitles.speaker: Instructor Vale
subtitles.text: Exercise complete. The same rules apply in skirmish and multiplayer.

subtitles.speaker: Instructor Vale
subtitles.text: Restart the checkpoint and keep the required training assets alive.
